<view class="page"><view class="club-page-banner"><view class="club-eyebrow">BERLIN FC</view><view class="club-banner-title">战术导入导出</view><view class="club-banner-subtitle">备份与迁移，保留球队的每一套配合</view><image class="club-banner-mark" src="/assets/team-badge.png" mode="aspectFit" aria-hidden="true"/></view><page-state skeleton-type="form" loading="{{loading}}" error="{{error}}" bind:retry="refresh"/><block wx:if="{{!loading&&!error&&admin}}"><view class="card"><view class="section-title"><text class="step-number">01</text>导入战术备份</view><view wx:if="{{recoveryBlocked}}" class="warning">上次导入未确认且原任务内容已不在内存。请先核对战术列表，避免再次导入产生重复。</view><button disabled="{{loading}}" wx:if="{{recoveryBlocked}}" id="transfer-check" bindtap="checkList" class="ui-button ui-block" size="mini">查看战术列表</button><button disabled="{{loading}}" wx:if="{{recoveryBlocked}}" id="transfer-resolve" bindtap="resolveRecovery" class="ui-button ui-block" size="mini">已核对，解除新导入限制</button><view class="hint">选择网页导出的 JSON 战术集，最多 8 MiB。包含战术及历史版本，不覆盖现有模板；具名文件默认核对去重。</view><view class="actions"><button id="transfer-choose" bindtap="choose" disabled="{{loading || (busy||pending||recoveryBlocked)}}" class="ui-button" size="mini">选择 JSON 文件</button></view><view wx:if="{{fileName}}" class="summary"><view class="filename">{{fileName}}</view><view class="transfer-count">{{tacticCount}} 套战术 · {{versionCount}} 个历史版本</view><button wx:if="{{namedCollection}}" id="transfer-copy" size="mini" class="ui-button copy-option {{asCopy?'is-selected':''}}" bindtap="toggleCopy" disabled="{{loading||busy||pending||recoveryBlocked}}" aria-role="checkbox" aria-checked="{{asCopy}}"><view class="copy-check" aria-hidden="true">{{asCopy?'✓':''}}</view><text>作为独立副本导入</text></button></view><view wx:if="{{pending}}" class="warning">上次导入结果待确认。重试使用同一任务，不重复新建。</view><button wx:if="{{fileName}}" class="primary ui-button ui-block" id="transfer-import" bindtap="importFile" disabled="{{loading || (busy)}}" loading="{{busy}}" size="mini">{{pending?'核对并重试导入':asCopy?'确认导入独立副本':namedCollection?'确认导入并核对':'确认追加导入'}}</button></view><view class="card"><view class="section-title"><text class="step-number">02</text>导出完整战术集</view><view class="hint">仅含当前球队战术及版本，不含登录凭据或俱乐部账号资料。</view><view class="warning export-privacy">战术中的队员姓名及比赛备注会保留，请妥善保管。</view><button id="transfer-export" bindtap="exportFile" disabled="{{loading || (busy)}}" class="ui-button ui-block" size="mini">生成临时 JSON</button><button wx:if="{{exportReady}}" id="transfer-save" bindtap="saveLocal" disabled="{{loading || (busy)}}" class="ui-button ui-block" size="mini">保存到本机</button><view wx:if="{{exportReady}}" class="warning export-temporary">文件仅临时保存在小程序本地，离开本页会清理；不会自动分享到聊天。系统保存能力受当前微信客户端支持情况限制。</view></view><view wx:if="{{message}}" class="hint">{{message}}</view><view wx:if="{{actionError}}" class="error">{{actionError}}</view></block></view>
<business-dialog id="business-dialog"/>
